source: Social Security Administration, Period Life Table 2023, as used in the 2026 Trustees Report (https://www.ssa.gov/oact/STATS/table4c6.html). Read Nov 20 2026.
notes: Number of lives out of 100,000 born, at exact age. A period table applies one year's death rates to everyone, so it leaves out future improvements in mortality; people with higher incomes and better health also tend to live longer than the population average.
